claim_boundary: Primary research supports serial dependence as a measurable departure from a random walk and reports statistically significant lower-order autocorrelation in historical 1H Bitcoin returns, but the Bitcoin evidence also finds negative first-order dependence, unstable higher-horizon behavior and no direct profit claim. Other cryptocurrency research reports both intraday momentum and reversal, while a separate Bitcoin forecasting study finds hourly returns generally weak-form efficient and regime dependent. Exactly one separately frozen equal-capital historical screen may therefore test whether unusually persistent within-day return signs distinguish robust DRA positive-momentum entries; failure closes the family without tuning.

feature_contract.formula: count of strictly same-sign adjacent pairs among the 22 pairs formed from the 23 close-to-close returns wholly inside the latest complete UTC day, divided by 22, then divided by the median of the prior 20 complete UTC-day shares

prior_matrix.finding: The variance-ratio framework links serial return dependence to departures from random-walk variance scaling, while rejection of a random walk does not by itself establish a profitable trading rule.
prior_matrix.identity: Lo and MacKinlay, Stock Market Prices Do Not Follow Random Walks: Evidence from a Simple Specification Test (1988)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Weekly US equity variance ratios do not prescribe a Bitcoin H1 sign statistic, direction, normalization, admission threshold or DRA strategy effect.

prior_matrix.finding: Historical BTC/USD and XBT/USD samples showed statistically significant lower-order 1H autocorrelation and rolling first-order autocorrelation that stayed negative; the authors explicitly state that this evidence alone is insufficient to extract profits.
prior_matrix.identity: Tartakovsky et al., Autocorrelation of returns in major cryptocurrency markets (2020)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Bitfinex spot and BitMEX perpetual evidence through 2019 does not establish modern OKX DRA alpha, and negative correlation is a co-equal challenge to the proposed persistence direction.

prior_matrix.finding: A cryptocurrency study reports both intraday momentum and reversal predictability rather than one universally stable direction.
prior_matrix.identity: Wen, Bouri, Xu and Zhao, Intraday return predictability in the cryptocurrency markets: Momentum, reversal, or both (2022)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Cross-cryptocurrency intraday predictors and their timing strategy do not validate a within-day sign-pair share or DRA admission rule.

prior_matrix.finding: A Bitcoin forecasting comparison reports that hourly BTC/USD returns were generally weak-form efficient and that any predictability depended on market regime.
prior_matrix.identity: Atsalakis et al., Forecasting Bitcoin with technical analysis: A not-so-random forest? (2021)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Model-level forecast results do not settle the exact sign-persistence proxy, but they forbid assuming stable hourly transfer or strategy value.

real_time_design_requirements: Use exactly the 24 hourly closes wholly contained in the latest complete UTC day; form 23 close-to-close returns and 22 adjacent pairs without the preceding day's close or any later bar.
Count a pair as persistent only when the two returns have a strictly positive product; zero returns remain in the fixed denominator and are never deleted or carried forward.
Divide the daily persistence share by the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day shares; a non-positive prior median fails closed without an epsilon or alternate normalization.
Keep the DRA parent, positive-momentum direction, lot cost, capacity, exits, fee, adverse slippage, cooldown and fill clock unchanged.
Freeze primary 1.0 and neighbors 0.8 and 1.2 before outcome access; do not search a different relation, lookback, sign rule, lag, autocorrelation estimator or threshold.
Require Design and Validation PnL improvement, annual breadth, path-risk non-inferiority, holding support and neighbor stability; otherwise close the family.
Do not open post-2024 OOS or create a candidate from this prior audit.
uncertainty: A 22-pair sign share is a coarse magnitude-neutral proxy and not a formal autocorrelation or variance-ratio test.
Historical studies disagree on direction and stability, and exchange, period and sampling differences limit transfer to OKX DRA.
The feature can select participation rather than causal alpha, so equal-capital realized, unrealized, drawdown, holding and annual breadth must remain visible together.
No post-2024 evidence, OOS, candidate, runtime filter or Trading path was accessed or authorized.
